description.value: Devonshire Flowers & Food is an independent convenience shop on Goldstream Avenue combining grocery staples with a flower offering — an unusual pairing that gives the store a local, neighbourhood character. Located on a key cycling corridor west of Victoria toward Langford, it sits in a two-storey building and would serve as a potential resupply point for touring cyclists heading in or out of the city. Its dual identity as both a market and flower shop makes it a distinctive stop on the route.
